cause_quote: The provider-rail redesign added `.chat-controls__model-menu { height: 350px; flex: 0 1 350px; }` on desktop, giving the empty picker the same fixed height as a populated one.
user_saw: On an unconfigured installation, opening the composer’s model control showed an oversized picker with a search field and no models.
summary: The fix replaces the composer’s picker with a direct Set up a model button when the catalog is confirmed empty and setup is available.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #192135 and confirmed that the empty picker sized to its content and offered a working setup action inside the menu. The redesign imposed a 350px desktop height that still applied to the empty automatic-account state at the fix’s parent. The fix addresses that presentation regression by moving setup directly into the composer.
